ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a soil food web diagram. In the lower-left area, there is a box labeled “Organic Matter.” From this box, an outgoing arrow labeled “Simple sugars” points toward a box labeled “Bacteria” near the lower middle of the diagram. Reasoning: Following the arrow from “Organic Matter” shows that it goes to “Bacteria,” so the organism feeding on organic matter is bacteria.
